definitions.error_free: run completed and no scored cell has a failure class (Table IV OK)
definitions.agreeing: error-free and every scored cell equal at E4 or finer (no DIFF, no UNCOMPARABLE)
definitions.agreeing_E2: error-free and every scored cell equal at E2 or finer
definitions.introduced_DIFF: a cell whose grade worsens to DIFF (pure definition), the 16 printed-form cells excluded

failure_categories: API removed or changed by pandas
